definitions.gloss: home visit (by a teacher to a pupil's family)
definitions.explanation: A Japanese school custom in which a teacher visits each pupil's home, usually early in the school year, to meet the family and learn about the home environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There will be a home visit next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher came to our house for a home visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: My mother hurriedly tidied up the rooms before the home visit.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧ (household) + ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧ (visit). A familiar event in Japanese primary and junior-high schooling, typically held in spring. Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a home visit
- {家庭訪問|かていほうもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: the day of the home visit
- ⟦{担任|たんにん}→担任：16408_tannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家庭訪問|かていほうもん}: home visit by the homeroom teacher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧: interview; one-on-one meeting — teacher and parent meet, but usually at the school
- ⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧: a visit — the general word, with no school connotation
